$comment: PRODUCTION rate cards: what the UPSTREAM provider charges Kaana, per deployment. Baked into the image at /etc/kaana-rates/provider-rates.json and read when the serving task sets KAANA_PROVIDER_RATES_PATH to that path. Never a customer price (docs/cost.md). Amounts are integers in 1e-12 USD.

One file is one immutable rate-card version, registered append-only in provider_rate_card_versions at startup. A changed price, or another deployment, is a NEW rateCardVersionId; reusing an id with different content stops the process.

rc_xai_realtime_2026_09_30: xAI Voice Agent (grok-voice-think-fast-2.0) under Kaana's xai-realtime slug, deployment id read back from the production inventory. xAI's list price, read 2026-09-30 at https://docs.x.ai/developers/models/speech-to-speech and https://x.ai/news/grok-voice-think-fast-2: audio $0.08 / minute; text input $0.004 per conversation.item.create. A push-to-talk session is billed for audio sent and received (audio_input_milliseconds, audio_output_milliseconds); a server_vad session for its duration (session_milliseconds), never both for one span. $0.08 / 60000 ms = 1333333.33 x 1e-12 USD per ms, truncated to 1333333 ($0.07999998/min). $0.004 = 4000000000 x 1e-12 USD per text item (requests).
